newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Zeitler - monetary policy aimed at mid-term.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Zeitler - monetary policy aimed at mid-term.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Franz-Christoph Zeitler repeated the German central bank's standard line on objectives of monetary policy on Thursday, saying he favours basing interest rate decisions on an intermediate time horizon.
"Monetary policy measures should not be based on short-term, occasionally irrational swings in interest rates and currencies," Zeitler wrote in a magazine article published on Thursday.
Zeitler, who is also president of the regional state central bank of Bavaria, warned that inflation could result if companies excessively sought short-term profits.
